name: Coinbase for Agents
description: Trade crypto, equities and derivatives, check balances and pay for x402 data from your Coinbase account via Coinbase's remote MCP server or CLI, for traders.

skills.name: Market Data
skills.description: Fetches prices, 24-hour volume, order books, recent trades and OHLCV candles for products tradable on Coinbase.

skills.name: Place Orders
skills.description: Previews, creates, edits and cancels market and limit orders, and lists orders and fills on your Coinbase account.

skills.name: Portfolios and Balances
skills.description: Lists account balances and portfolios, shows allocation and unrealized PnL, and moves funds between portfolios.

skills.name: Conversions
skills.description: Quotes and executes conversions between currencies on Coinbase, then checks the status of each conversion.

skills.name: x402 Payments
skills.description: Discovers curated x402 data services and pays for them from your Coinbase USDC balance, up to a payment ceiling.
